title: Infinity Goes Mobile: Manage International Payments Anywhere
summary: The Infinity app is officially live. Manage international payments, stay on top of compliance, track transactions and get instant payment notifications.
body_markdown:
Last month, a freelance designer messaged us at 11 pm asking if she could check whether her client's payment had landed as she was travelling and she only had her phone. She had to wait until she was back at her laptop to log in and check. That kind of gap, between when a payment happens and when you actually find out about it, is exactly what our new mobile app is built to close.


We're excited to announce that **Infinity is now available as a mobile app on both IOS and Android.** Infinity mobile app brings the same fast, transparent way to[receive international payments](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/payment-gateway-for-freelancers-in-india) straight to your phone. Whether you're a freelancer between client calls, an agency owner travelling for work, or an exporter who needs to track payments on the move, you no longer need to be at your desk to stay on top of your cross-border payments.


Here's what's new, what stays the same, and how to get started.


## **TL;DR**


-


Infinity's mobile app is now live, with the same core features as the web platform: receive international payments, get[FIRA](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/what-is-fira-its-importance-for-freelancers-in-india) automatically, and settle to your Indian bank account within 24 hours.


-


Flat 0.5% fee, inclusive of all charges, no change in the charges from the web platform.


-


AD-1 certified and RBI-regulated, so compliance and documentation work exactly as it does today.


-


Built for freelancers, agencies, SaaS companies and exporters who want to track and manage payments without being tied to a desktop.


-


Available to download now. It is available on the[Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.infinityapp.in) for Android users and for IOS users it is available on the[Apple App Store.](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/infinity-global-payments/id6792675282)


## **What's New: Infinity on Mobile**


The mobile app isn't a separate product, it's the same Infinity you already know, redesigned for your phone. Everything that made the web platform useful for receiving international payments is available on the go:


-


**Receive international payments** using your Infinity receiving account details, the same way you would on the web.


-


**Get notified instantly** , whenever a payment lands into your account.


-


**Track payment status in real time** , so you know the moment a client payment is on its way or has settled, instead of finding out only when you log in from a laptop.


-


**Access your FIRA instantly** , generated automatically for every payment you receive, and available to download or share directly from your phone.


-


**Use the free**[FIRA Analyser](https://www.infinityapp.in/fira-analyzer) to make sense of your remittance history, wherever you are.


-


**Check your settlement timeline** , with payments settling to your Indian bank account within 24 hours, same as always.


If you've been using Infinity on the web, nothing about how you receive international payments changes. What changes is how easily you can check in on them.


## **Why We Built a Mobile App**


Freelancers, agency owners, and exporters don't work from one screen all day. You're on client calls, travelling, or simply away from your laptop when a payment update comes in. A few reasons this mobile launch matters:


-


**You shouldn't have to wait to find out you've been paid.** Real-time visibility on your phone means fewer "let me check when I'm back at my desk" moments.


-


**Documentation should be one tap away.** Need to share an FIRA with your CA or a client while you're out? Now you can, without opening a laptop.


-


**International payments don't run on a 9-to-5 schedule.** Neither should your ability to track them.


## **Who This Is For**


-


**Freelancers** who want to see payment updates the moment they happen, without being at a desk.


-


**Agencies** managing multiple client payments and needing quick access to FIRA documentation for reconciliation.


-


**SaaS founders and exporters** who travel frequently and need visibility into cross-border payments wherever they are.
